result.title: Negation without Confusion: Decomposing Bias and Recomposing Style in Text Embeddings for Negation-aware Image Generation
result.summary: Negation-aware image generation remains challenging for text-to-image diffusion models, which often struggle with negation due to implicit linguistic biases that are deeply entangled within text representations. As a result, bias-aligned semantics frequently dominate over intended negative constraints. To overcome this limitation, we propose a simple training-free method of Decompose and Recompose text embedding (Dero), which constructs a semantic-preserving subspace and a bias subspace using auxiliary prompts and performs semantic disentanglement based on bidirectional SVD. By decomposing entangled representations and selectively recomposing disentangled semantic components, Dero realigns text representations toward intended negation semantics while restoring residual stylistic features to preserve semantic fidelity and image quality. As a model-agnostic inference-time framework operating solely on text representations, Dero can be seamlessly applied to diverse diffusion architectures, including both U-Net and DiT based models. Extensive experiments on both object- and concept-level negation demonstrate consistent improvements in negation-aware image generation, achieving stronger text-image alignment, better semantic fidelity, and higher human preference scores.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练的 Dero：用辅助提示构建语义保持子空间与偏置子空间，通过双向 SVD 解耦纠缠的文本嵌入并选择性重组，以缓解文生图扩散模型中的否定语义失效问题。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按「语义 / 偏置」方向分解表征再选择性重组的做法，可能为 LVR 中区分任务必要视觉证据与干扰语义、筛选 latent 假设提供可供核查的线索；但作用对象是文本嵌入与图像生成，能否迁移到多模态内部状态尚需核查。
